## On the exchange page
## 🆕 Free Subsidy Voucher
New and existing users can register to claim a free Subsidy Voucher, covering 7 days of loss protection. 3,000 vouchers available, given out randomly on a first-come, first-served basis until supplies run out.
## 🔥 Liquidation Subsidy
Users who are unable to claim the free Subsidy Voucher can place a copy trading order by copying a designated trader during the event. If the first copy trading order is liquidated, users will be subsidized based on the actual loss amount, up to 20 USDT per order.
## *The two benefits can't be combined. Each user can only enjoy one.
## 📈 Consecutive Copy Trading Rewards
Maintain copy trading funds of ≥ 20 USDT each day to count as a valid copy trading day.
## 3 consecutive days
- Net deposit ≤ 100 USDT → 20 USDT Position Voucher
- Net deposit > 100 USDT → 50 USDT Position Voucher
## 7 consecutive days
- Net deposit ≤ 100 USDT → 20 USDT Subsidy Voucher + 20 USDT Position Voucher
- Net deposit > 100 USDT → 50 USDT Subsidy Voucher + 50 USDT Position Voucher
*Net deposit = Copy trading deposits during the event - Copy trading withdrawals during the event (including canceled copy trading)
## Fixed-Ratio Copy Trading Subsidy Voucher subsidizes you based on the proportion of your investment.
Fixed ratio = the more you invest
the higher your protection, paid out proportionally.
Payout amount = copy trading principal × voucher subsidy rate
If no amount is specified on the voucher, the payout follows the principal ratio in full. If an amount is specified on the voucher, the payout will not exceed that amount.
The voucher isn't consumed
when you profit from copy trading, so it continues to protect your future copy trades.
For losses
the system automatically pays USDT to your account at settlement. No manual application needed.
If you encounter any issues during Copy trading or want to learn more about Copy trading benefits, join the Copy Trading Community.
📋 Event Rules
- Only copy trading with this week's recommended traders counts. If you were already copying a recommended trader before the event, only deposits and copy trading volume during the event period will count.
- If you copy multiple traders, your net deposit is calculated based on the trader you copied for the most consecutive days. If the consecutive days are the same, the highest net deposit will apply.
- Valid copy trading within 3 business days after the event ends still counts toward your copy trading duration, but only trading volume generated during the event period will count.
Each round of the recurring Copy Trading reward event divides users into two groups based on their Copy Trading deposit amount: below 100 USDT and 100 USDT or above. Rewards will be distributed accordingly to the top 100 users in each group ranked by Copy Trading volume, for a total of 200 winners per round. A minimum Copy Trading volume of 1 USDT is required to qualify.
Only copy trading volume generated from copying a designated trader for at least 3 days will count toward the total trading volume. The eligible volume will be calculated based on the maximum qualifying copy trading volume. Any copy trading volume that does not meet the minimum copying duration or designated trader requirements will be excluded.
Liquidation Compensation Benefit: Applies only to the first Copy Trading order placed during the promotion period by following a designated lead trader. After liquidation, the compensation amount will be credited to your account as Trial Fund. The Liquidation Compensation Benefit cannot be used in combination with the free subsidy voucher benefit.
- Rewards will be distributed within 5 business days after the event ends. Subsidy Vouchers, Position Vouchers, and Trial Funds are all valid for 7 days.
- BingX will cancel participation eligibility and all rewards for any violations, including volume manipulation or use of multiple accounts.
- BingX reserves the right of final interpretation for this event.

OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
🦃 Thanksgiving referral special: up to 50 USDC each
Invite friends to CEX•IO between November 20 and 30.
🟢 When they buy crypto or make a fiat deposit of $100+, you both get a reward of up to 50 USDC.
## Pass the link, not the gravy
🔸 Copy your referral link
🔸 Your friend signs up through it
🔸 They buy crypto or make a fiat deposit of $100+ by November 30
🔸 You both get up to 50 USDC
➡️ No referral limit: every friend counts
➡️ Your 30% referral commission stays on top
📌 Reward amount depends on your region. Terms apply.
🌐 Available in the US, Cape Verde, Serbia, Albania, Kosovo, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Jamaica, Azerbaijan, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Georgia, Armenia, Bahamas, Barbados, Mauritius, Saint Lucia, Antigua and Barbuda, Bermuda, Guatemala, Curacao, Dominica, Dominican Republic, Panama, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines

## On the exchange page
Invite your friends to join CEX.IO by sharing your referral link, and you’ll each receive a 25 USDC reward in your wallets.
## How to participate
Click "Get Referral Link" and copy your unique link (generate it if needed).
Invite friends
Send your link to anyone you know — they just need to sign up using it to get started.
They make a fiat deposit
Your friend must deposit $100+ in fiat or buy crypto for the same amount to unlock the reward.
Get rewarded
Once your friend's qualifying transaction is confirmed, you will each receive a reward. You can claim your reward in the Reward Center. Note: The review process can take 1–2 days.
## Rules and Important Information
## Period
This promo runs from November 20, 2026, to November 30, 2026.
## Eligibility
Open to users in: Cape Verde, Serbia, Albania, Kosovo, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Jamaica, Azerbaijan, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Georgia, Armenia, Bahamas, Barbados, Mauritius, Saint Lucia, Antigua and Barbuda, Bermuda, Guatemala, Curaçao, Dominica, Dominican Republic, Panama, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. Both the referrer and the referred friend must be registered in an eligible country.
## Limits and Cap
You may invite as many new users as you like, but the crypto reward is limited to the first 40 Qualifying Referrals, awarded strictly on a first-come, first-served basis as recorded in CEX.IO's systems. Each Qualifying Referral results in two Reward credits, one to the Referring User and one to the Referred User, and the Promotion therefore provides for up to 80 Reward credits in total. Once the limit is reached, the 25 USDC reward is no longer available — even if the promotion period is still active.
## Reward structure & crediting
This reward is separate from and in addition to your standard 30% referral commission. Rewards are automatically credited to your account once you claim them in the Reward Center. You will receive an in-app notification when the reward is ready to claim.
## Qualification requirements
Only new CEX.IO users qualify as referred users. The referred user must complete a fiat deposit of $100 or more or purchase crypto worth $100 or more to qualify for the reward.
